name: s81su_smhr
structural_change: S81U-SMH2 (10-17): root regional cluster (x1 per head) of the split per-head SM subtree (see s81su_smhq): row sum smc + max/den root smr with their SRL link, own clock pin + registered reset relay; quad links arrive registered (station 1 in the quad), max/den broadcast leaves registered.
why_floorplan: smc + smr side by side on the 43.2 lattice between a 43-um S band (q_e + control stations, clk) and a 43-um N band (q_mx stations); pin-bound: ~590 pins S (1.7/um) + 512 q_mx pins N (1.5/um), the quads sit on both sides of the root in the slice; 346 x 216 um. g1 (one face, 346 x 251) failed fill 31% (pin demand S 78%).

job.purpose: S81U-SMH2: root regional cluster (x1 per head) of the S81-DV per-head SM subtree (bench: tools/s81_su_sm/sms_bench.sh SMT=1).

why_clock: SMH 10-18: clock = balanced spine with child-insertion leaf targets from each child's ROUTED boundary-register insertion (child_clock_ref boundary), so the glue pin flops and the children's pin flops tick together. The 10-17 g3 TritonCTS trial (insertion-cap driven) gave pin-flop spread 144 ps; the g2 spine gave 24.8 ps (insertion > 300 ps is guidance under 0dq).
